messages:
morgan: Quick UX issue — paste a param snippet missing "type" and the editor saves then shows a top banner "Schema invalid" with no clue where the error is.

sam: Pastes are the worst. We should show an inline marker and let users jump to it.

morgan: Repro: new function -> add param -> paste {"name":"addr"} -> save -> red banner, no inline focus.

kai: Perf note: we validate on save for big docs. Could add a debounced subtree lint for edits.

aisha: A11y: banners alone are vague to screen readers. Need role=alert with node path and a keyboard-focusable "Jump to error" link. Announce: "Schema error in parameter 'addr': missing type. Press Enter to jump."

sam: Microcopy for inline tooltip: "Missing required field: "type". Click or press Enter to focus."

kai: Dev plan: debounce 600ms, run quick JSONSchema on changed node, render inline icon button with aria-label, keep banner for fatal failures.

morgan: Also: run-history shows tool-call JSON blobs. Proposal: show a compact preview row (top keys + types) with keyboard-expand to lazy-load the full payload.

aisha: Ensure preview controls use aria-expanded/controls and moving focus into the tree when opened. Contrast and touch target checks too.

ux-bot: Created tickets: "schema-inline-lint+jump", "run-history-compact-preview" assigned to @sam/@kai.
